description: Proposed BMW 5 Series <-> competitor matches (manual review sidecar per agent-competitors.md). class_body and price_range stay null where no source established them.

comparisons.rationale: Beijing Benz long-wheelbase E-Class, the direct China-only rival to the 5 Series Li: same 2.0T 48V mild-hybrid 258 hp class, owners cross-shop it with the 530Li, and Autohome tests the two head to head.
comparisons.next_generation: Sohu lists 2026款 and 2026款 改款/改款二 E 260 L / E 300 L trims (204 hp / 259 hp); no successor details fetched

comparisons.rationale: FAW-Audi long-wheelbase A6L, the third member of the BBA executive-sedan trio; Sohu still lists 2026款 C8 trims (40/45/55 TFSI) alongside the new generation, and owners cross-shop it with the 5 Series Li and E-Class L, mostly on price.
comparisons.next_generation: All-new A6L (C9, PPC platform) on sale since March 2026 (https://carnewschina.com/2026/03/26/new-audi-a6l-started-sales-in-china-with-v6-powered-hev-system-for-386-hp/); A6L e-tron (PPE) BEV pre-sale from March 2026 (https://cnevpost.com/2026/03/25/audi-begins-pre-sales-a6l-e-tron-china/)

comparisons.rationale: New-generation China LWB A6L on the PPC platform (2.0T 48V mild hybrid, 2.0T full-hybrid quattro, 3.0T V6 hybrid), priced from 322,900 yuan, with NOA and optional LiDAR. Autohome's buying guide says the entry price is well below the 5 Series and E-Class bases; Autohome editors and one Sohu owner refer to it as C9.

FAW-Audi long-wheelbase electric sedan on PPE (800 V, 107 kWh, Huawei Qiankun ADS), the BEV rival to the i5 long-wheelbase; pre-sales opened 2026-03-25; Sohu (https://db.auto.sohu.com/model_6115) lists four 2026款 trims at 30.98-43.98万.

Indirect competitor one price tier below the 5 Series Li/i5. Sohu (https://db.auto.sohu.com/trim_181651/dianping) lists the 2026 SU7 at 21.99-30.39万 vs BMW 5 Series 36.8-52.59万 on the same page. Autohome's SU7 page (cited url) lists BMW 5 Series among its popular comparisons (热门对比), and SU7 owners on Sohu benchmark it against BMW 3 Series/Audi A4; CarNewsChina benchmarks it against Tesla Model 3. Best-selling premium EV sedan in China; sets buyer expectations for HMI, phone ecosystem, ADAS and value that the 5 Series Li is judged against.

Direct price overlap: Sohu lists the 2024 ET7 at 42.8-45.8万, inside the 5 Series Li/i5 range. Executive-sedan format with a 3,060 mm wheelbase, air suspension and rear-comfort focus. A Sohu owner explicitly cross-shopped BMW, Mercedes, Audi and Lexus before buying. No 2025/2026 update found in fetched sources; still listed on Sohu.

Indirect competitor, about 20.39-24.39万 (Sohu 2026款), below the 5 Series Li. CarNewsChina positions it as an alternative to the Xiaomi SU7, Tesla Model 3 and BMW i3, not the 5 Series. It is included because it is one of the main Chinese premium EV sedans competing for the same tech-oriented buyers.

Indirect competitor at 22.98-28.98万 (Autohome, 2025 update; the rival it names is the Xiaomi SU7). Included because Sohu S7 owners explicitly compare it with a family BMW 5 Series (more space, more enjoyable to drive) and an Audi A6L, so it draws buyers from BBA households. It is Huawei's ADS/HarmonyOS showcase sedan. Sales were called 'underwhelming' by CarNewsChina in 2024-03.

Fifth model, chosen instead of Xpeng P7+/BYD Han L: it is the only candidate with a fetched source naming the BMW 5 Series as a rival. CnEVPost (2025-11) says it competes with the Mercedes E-Class, BMW 5 Series and Audi A6L. The 2025 refresh is priced from 30.98万 (EREV) and 32.98-36.98万 (BEV), with a 3,050 mm wheelbase. A Sohu owner test-drove a BMW i5 and chose the S9 for its standard equipment. Li Auto and AITO have no sedan; this is HIMA's executive sedan.

comparisons.launched: 2025 (revealed March 2025; ADAC DE catalogue lists variants from 12/2025)
comparisons.rationale: Volvo's only saloon in Europe and a 5.0 m E-segment BEV aimed squarely at the i5: Auto Express (Apr 2026) names the BMW i5 and Audi A6 e-tron as the obvious alternatives and benchmarks its dimensions against the i5; Move Electric compares it directly with the i5 on interior, ride and boot; ADAC lists the i5 as a segment competitor. Chosen as the Volvo/Polestar representative (Polestar 5 too new, Polestar 4 is an SUV-coupe).

5.1 m Chinese premium BEV saloon sold in Germany, the Netherlands and the Nordics, with battery swap and battery-rental pricing. Auto Swiat (Mar 2024, with Auto Bild photos) ran it head to head against the BMW i5 M60 and Mercedes-AMG EQE 53 (i5 won 621 points; ET7 tied second on 572). Chosen as the Chinese-brand challenger that is closest in size and price to the 5 Series in Europe; BYD Seal/NIO ET5 are D-segment, BYD Han is barely sold in the EU.

comparisons.launched: 2021 (refresh); UK return in 2023 as left-hand drive only (Auto Express); DE variants through 04/2026
comparisons.rationale: Tesla's E-segment saloon (5.02 m, about the length of a 5 Series per Auto Express). UK press group-tests it against the i5: Autocar ran Model S Plaid vs BMW i5 M60 vs Mercedes-AMG EQE 53 (Autocar itself returned 402; verdict taken from the BMWBlog summary, Jan 2024: EQE 53 first, Model S Plaid second, i5 M60 third). Kept as the segment-correct Tesla even though it is being discontinued and has almost no current-generation European owner voice.
comparisons.next_generation: Discontinued, no successor named: ADAC catalogue shows Model S Plaid 10/25-04/26 (Modellende 04/26); AutoScout24 (Jan 2026) says production ends in late 2026 and Fremont lines are converted to Optimus robots.

comparisons.rationale: Not a segment rival (4.72 m D-segment, from about EUR 37k in DE), but included as Tesla's current volume saloon in Europe and the software/efficiency/charging benchmark with real European owner voice: Driver Power 2026 ranks it 1st of 50 cars (Auto Express), ADAC benchmarks it against the BMW i4 on price and efficiency. No i5/5 Series twin test was found; the Model S (segment rival) has almost no current-generation owner voice in Europe.

Direct upper-midsize (E-segment) rival of the 5 Series in Germany and the UK with the same powertrain mix (48V mild-hybrid petrol/diesel, petrol and diesel PHEV); ADAC names the BMW 5er Touring as a direct competitor and German press runs the E 220 d against the 520d head to head.

Mercedes' electric E-segment saloon and the direct rival of the BMW i5 in Germany and the UK; AUTO BILD tests the EQE 350 head to head against the i5 eDrive40 at near-identical base prices (70,995 vs 70,200 EUR).
Audi's new combustion/PHEV E-segment model (originally planned as the A7) and the direct rival of the 520i/520d/530e in Germany; ADAC names the BMW 5er Touring as its first competitor.

Audi's dedicated 800-V electric E-segment model on the PPE platform and the direct rival of the BMW i5 / i5 Touring; ADAC names the i5 Touring as its first competitor and AUTO ZEITUNG tests the A6 Avant e-tron quattro head to head against the i5 xDrive40 Touring.

powertrains: ICE (48V mild hybrid: E 350 2.0T, E 450 3.0T I6)
comparisons.rationale: Mercedes' core mid-size luxury sedan and the most direct US rival of the BMW 5 Series (G60). MBUSA lists the MY2027 sedan as E 350 from $65,200, E 450 4MATIC $73,700 and AMG E 53 Hybrid $91,100, a line-up that mirrors 530i/540i/550e. US press pits the E450 directly against the 540i (Autoblog comparison, Car and Driver 540i test) and KBB runs a 5 Series vs E-Class comparison. BMW's own G60 US feedback mentions Mercedes about 30 times.
comparisons.next_generation: Comprehensive facelift of the combustion/PHEV W214 reported for 2027, adopting the design language of the coming electric E-Class (see us_mercedes-O001).

comparisons.rationale: Mercedes' electric mid-size luxury sedan and the direct US rival of the BMW i5 (G60 BEV). KBB's 2025 EQE review benchmarks it against the i5 eDrive40 (range 308 vs 295 mi, trunk 11 vs 17.3 cu ft, similar ~30 min 10-80 % charging); Canadian comparison tests (AutoTrader.ca, Auto123) pit the AMG EQE against the i5 M60. MBUSA still lists a 2026 EQE sedan (EQE 320+, 96 kWh, 308 mi). BMW's own G60 US feedback mentions Mercedes about 30 times.
comparisons.next_generation: Electric E-Class ('E-Class with EQ Technology', MB.EA platform, three-box sedan) reported to replace the EQE from 2027 (see us_mercedes-O002).

comparisons.launched: 2020 (MY2021 in US; Electrified G80 from MY2023; refresh with 27-inch OLED display from MY2025)
comparisons.rationale: Midsize premium rear/all-wheel-drive sedan priced below the 5 Series; Genesis positions it directly against the 5 Series, and the Electrified G80 is a battery-electric alternative to the i5. Press comparison tests pit it directly against the 540i.

comparisons.launched: 2018 (MY2019 in US; refresh MY2022; last model year MY2025)
comparisons.rationale: Best-selling Japanese premium midsize sedan in the US (ES 250 AWD, ES 300h full hybrid, ES 350 V6). Front-wheel-drive, comfort-focused alternative that buyers cross-shop with the 5 Series on price, comfort and reliability. powertrains: ICE includes the ES 300h non-plug-in hybrid (schema has no HEV value).
comparisons.next_generation: 8th-generation ES (MY2026) on sale in the US: ES 350h hybrid, ES 350e and ES 500e battery-electric

comparisons.launched: 2026 (MY2026 in US; ES 350e/500e EVs first, ES 350h hybrid from about mid-2026)
comparisons.rationale: All-new ES on a multi-pathway platform offering hybrid (ES 350h, 244 hp, AWD optional) and battery-electric (ES 350e FWD, ES 500e AWD, about 75 kWh) versions; directly overlaps the 5 Series / i5 split of combustion and electric variants at a lower price. No official generation code published on fetched pages, so a descriptive label is used. powertrains: ICE stands for the non-plug-in hybrid.

comparisons.launched: 2019 (MY2020 in US; refresh MY2025 with 33-inch display and Super Cruise)
comparisons.rationale: Rear/all-wheel-drive American premium sedan sized between the 3 and 5 Series and priced near a well-equipped 3 Series; Cadillac's only remaining mainstream sedan alongside the CT4, offered with 2.0T, 3.0TT V6 and V-Series/Blackwing. Relevant as the domestic US alternative to the 5 Series on price, hands-free driving (Super Cruise) and screen tech.
comparisons.next_generation: KBB page shows a news item (Oct 2025) that Cadillac will redesign the CT5; timing and powertrains not confirmed on fetched pages

comparisons.rationale: Smaller than the 5 Series, but BMW's own G60 US feedback names Tesla about 60 times, mostly for Supercharger access, range and software. The refreshed Model 3 is the volume Tesla sedan that i5 shoppers cross-shop, and it sets the benchmark for charging, efficiency and price.

A large luxury liftback BEV in the i5's size and price bracket (KBB lists the i5 as starting slightly below the Model S). US i5 owners name Tesla as a cross-shop and charging benchmark. It is the range, Supercharger and software reference point for the i5.
comparisons.next_generation: No successor. A KBB news item dated 2026-01-29 on the 2025 Model S page says Tesla will end the Model S and Model X the next quarter, so US availability in late 2026 needs checking.

comparisons.launched: US MY2025 (Sportback body only in the US; S6 Sportback e-tron is the performance variant)
comparisons.rationale: Audi's mid-size electric counterpart to the i5; cars.com names the BMW i5 and Mercedes EQE as its primary rivals. It undercuts the i5 on range (up to 392 mi), on cargo space and on charging (800 V, 270 kW, 10-80% in 21 min).

comparisons.launched: US MY2026 (all-new generation; replaces the C8 sedan)
comparisons.rationale: Direct ICE rival to the G60 530i/540i. KBB benchmarks it against the BMW 540i xDrive and the Mercedes E-Class. The only US powertrain is a 3.0 V6 (362 hp, quattro). In the US the C8 now survives only as the A6 allroad and RS 6 Avant, which are not sedans.
